charts.radarLegendFoot: Scale 0–100 relative to internal dashboard references, not population percentiles. Cadence and economy on the radar use placeholder values until they are computed from your activities.
charts.radarVolumeBody: Average weekly kilometers (last 4 weeks) compared to ~80 km as a high weekly reference (100 on the chart).
charts.radarConsistencyBody: Weeks with logged activity compared to ~12 weeks as a reference for consistency over time.
charts.radarIntensityBody: Last week’s load (TSS) compared to ~150 TSS as a demanding-week reference.
charts.radarRecoveryBody: Current form (TSB): higher values mean more room to train; negative values mean more accumulated fatigue.
charts.radarCadenceBody: Steps per minute (technique and leg turnover). Usually assessed in steady running; typical ranges depend on height and pace.
charts.radarEconomyBody: Running economy: how efficient you are at submaximal paces (lower physiological cost at the same pace; labs measure this with oxygen uptake). Here it is indicative until linked to your HR/pace series.
